messages.content: I need to create a plan for the authentication module.

We need to implement OAuth2 with JWT tokens. The flow involves redirecting the user to the auth provider, receiving a callback with an authorization code, and exchanging that code for tokens. We'll store refresh tokens in an HTTP-only cookie.
Now I should outline the database schema for users.

Users table: id (UUID PK), email (unique, indexed), password_hash, display_name, created_at, updated_at. Roles table: id, name. UserRoles join table: user_id FK, role_id FK. All timestamps use UTC. We should add a composite index on session.user_id.
Now I should consider rate limiting.

Rate limiting should be implemented at the middleware level using Redis as the backing store. Use a sliding window algorithm with per-endpoint limits. Default: 100 requests per minute per user. Anonymous users get 20 per minute by IP. Return 429 with Retry-After header when exceeded.
Now I will design the middleware.

Global error handling should catch all unhandled exceptions and return a consistent JSON envelope: {error: code, message, details, request_id}. Log every 5xx with stack trace via the structured logger. Use a Sentry integration for production monitoring. Sanitize error messages in 4xx responses to avoid leaking internals.
